repo_root: Absolute repository path. Omit it with one root; a refusal lists the roots.
map_focus: File paths, path suffixes, module names, or symbol names that receive the map's ranking focus. A single string or a list of strings is accepted; a bare string reads as a one-element list. Use this when the target area is partly known; omit it for repository-wide orientation.
map_budget: Maximum tokens for the map. Omit it for automatic sizing in a 2000-8000 token band.
map_max_files: Maximum ranked files admitted to the repository map before symbol packing.
map_granularity: function lists symbols, file lists files alone, body adds budgeted bodies.
no_cache: Parse every file live, bypassing the cache.
tree_path: Optional repository-relative directory whose tracked subtree should be rendered. Omit it to render from the repository root.
tree_depth: Directory levels below the tree root.
tree_max_entries: Entries listed before the tree reports truncation.
stable_ids: Stable ids from map, overview, find, explain or locate.
expand_limit: Maximum symbols expanded in this call; additional requested identifiers are reported as omitted. Omit it to use the tool's default.
slice_lines: One [start, end] range or a list of them, 1-based and inclusive.
whole_file: The whole file, in place of lines.
find_limit: Maximum matching symbol cards returned by find_symbol. Omit it to use the tool's default.
reference_target: Stable id, qualified name or name.
reference_limit: Maximum sites, one per file in turn. Default 50.
shared_callers: Rank symbols whose callers overlap the target's instead: the does-a-utility-already-exist check.
explain_target: Stable id, qualified name or name. Ties list the others.
explain_limit: Maximum rows shown within each fan-in, fan-out, and import section of the explanation. Omit it to use the tool's default.
structure_operation: Structural view to compute: path traces precise symbol evidence; cycles reports import SCCs; communities partitions the relevance graph; diagram emits bounded Mermaid; health reports orphan candidates, unused exports, hubs and complexity hotspots.
path_source: path: a stable id, qualified name or file path.
path_target: path: a stable id, qualified name or file path.
include_unique: path: allow unique-name edges, which are retrieval evidence, not binding evidence.
include_ambiguous: path: allow name-only edges, where several definitions share the spelling.
structure_limit: Maximum cycles or communities returned, depending on the selected operation. Omit it to use the tool's default.
community_resolution: Larger values generally give smaller communities.
diagram_focus: Optional file path, path suffix, module name, or symbol name at the centre of a diagram operation. A single string or a list of strings is accepted; a diagram has one centre, so only the first list entry is used.
diagram_max_nodes: Nodes drawn before an elision node.
diagram_max_edges: Arrows drawn; the rest are counted.
orient_operation: The tool description says what each one takes.
symbols_operation: The tool description says what each one requires.
read_operation: The tool description says what each one takes.
orient_focus: Paths, path suffixes, module stems or symbol names that seed the ranking. A traceback frame, blob URL or path:line seeds the file it names. diagram uses the first entry.
orient_limit: Maximum rows: map files (default 10), communities, cycles, or rows per health section (default 20).
symbols_limit: Maximum rows: find and explain default 20, expand 10.
read_path: Repository-relative path: the file for slice, the subtree for dir.
history_target: Stable id from map, overview, find, explain or locate. A bare name is refused.
history_budget: Maximum tokens for commit bodies. Default 12000.
